full_name: Jennifer Cole | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Jennifer Cole conducts research on processes of social memory and forgetting; she has recently begun to focus on youth as a pivotal group through which to understand the social dynamics of intergenerational reproduction and change.
